##### Project general facts

Golf Place is a refined residential address by Prestige One, located in the vibrant setting of Dubai Sports City. Distinguished by its elegant architectural expression and carefully considered proportions, the development rises as a modern landmark overlooking expansive golf course landscapes. Designed to capture panoramic green views and natural light, Golf Place offers a serene yet dynamic living environment that blends contemporary aesthetics with the openness of its surroundings.

The project presents a selection of thoughtfully designed residences, each offering uninterrupted views of the lush golf course that define the character of the location. Spacious layouts, clean architectural lines, and an emphasis on comfort create homes suited for both end users and investors seeking long-term value. Golf Place embodies a balance of style, functionality, and tranquility, positioning itself as a desirable lifestyle destination within Dubai Sports City.

Residents enjoy access to a curated collection of premium amenities designed to elevate everyday living. A rooftop infinity pool provides a relaxing retreat with sweeping views, while the overall amenities offering supports a refined, leisure-focused lifestyle. Interiors are finished in a modern style using high-quality materials, complemented by boutique design by LACASA. Kitchens are fully equipped with Siemens and Bosch appliances, ensuring both performance and elegance, while residences are delivered unfurnished, allowing owners the freedom to personalize their living spaces.

##### Location description and benefits


Dubai Sports City offers a well-balanced blend of lifestyle, wellness, and convenient connectivity. The district features international sporting facilities, green open spaces, and a vibrant atmosphere that appeals equally to families and professionals. It’s a place where everything is within easy reach — from active recreation to peaceful downtime.

Its strategic location provides direct access to major roads such as Hessa Street, Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, and Al Khail Road, making it easy to reach Dubai Marina, JVC, Motor City, and even Dubai International Airport within minutes.

Residents enjoy a wide range of infrastructure, including prestigious schools, medical centers, supermarkets, and shopping malls such as City Centre Me’aisem and Mall of the Emirates. Beaches, golf courses, and parks are all just a short drive away, while the canal promenade within Sports City itself offers the perfect setting for evening walks, jogs, or weekend gatherings with friends and family.
